raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "absolute in-plane dimensions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies Lx:Ly = 6:1 but gives no absolute dimensions or coordinate length unit.",
      "readings": [
        "Full beam Lx = 6, Ly = 1; right half spans x = 3 to 6.",
        "Full beam Lx = 180, Ly = 30; right half spans x = 90 to 180."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "element counts in the optimized half-domain",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 states 180 by 30 elements before saying the right symmetric half is optimized. Appendix B explicitly uses a 90 by 30 half-domain and repeats Table 2's single-material CASE III objective and non-discreteness values.",
      "readings": [
        "180 by 30 describes the full beam; optimize a 90 by 30 half-domain with square elements.",
        "180 by 30 describes the optimized half-domain; the full beam has 360 by 30 elements, with element width equal to half the element height for a full-beam aspect ratio of 6:1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "physical beam supports",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 identifies a simply supported beam and refers to Fig. 2a, but the available prose and caption provide no support coordinates or supported node sets.",
      "readings": [
        "Single-node supports at the two bottom corners, x/Lx = 0 and 1, y/Ly = 0.",
        "Single-node bottom supports one element inboard from each end.",
        "Supports over one-element-wide bottom-edge patches adjoining the two ends."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_type",
      "entity": "displacement restraints at the outer support of the right half",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 says 'simply supported', and subsequent discussion mentions rollers and hinges, but their assignment and constrained displacement components are not specified in the prose.",
      "readings": [
        "Outer support is a vertical roller: uy = 0 and ux is free; enforce ux = 0 on the symmetry cut.",
        "Outer support is treated as a pin: ux = uy = 0, in addition to ux = 0 on the symmetry cut."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "point force applied to the half-domain",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies F = 10^-3, but Sec. 4.1.1 does not state whether that magnitude denotes the full-beam force or the force entered into the reduced model.",
      "readings": [
        "Full-beam force is 10^-3; apply 5 times 10^-4 to the half-domain.",
        "Apply 10^-3 to the half-domain; the mirrored full beam consequently carries 2 times 10^-3."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "elements adjoining the load and supports",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 describes material occupying load and support portions as an observed result, but supplies neither an explicit all-designable statement nor a prescribed passive-element mask.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive elements; all beam elements remain designable.",
        "Fix the single element adjoining each load or support point as solid.",
        "Fix a 2 by 2 element solid patch adjoining each load or support point."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.1 and 4 specify Young's modulus but give no Poisson's ratio for the single-material elastic model.",
      "readings": [
        "Constant Poisson's ratio 0.30.",
        "Constant Poisson's ratio 0.25.",
        "Constant Poisson's ratio 1/3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The 2-D example and bilinear quadrilateral elements are specified, but plane stress versus plane strain is not.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic plane stress.",
        "Isotropic plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness or explicit unit-thickness convention is supplied for the 2-D stiffness and volume calculations.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness of 1 coordinate length unit.",
        "Uniform thickness of 0.1 coordinate length unit."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "void stiffness Emin",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 and Eq. 33 describe Emin only as a 'very small stiffness' used to avoid singularity; its numerical value is absent.",
      "readings": [
        "Emin/Esolid = 10^-3.",
        "Emin/Esolid = 10^-6.",
        "Emin/Esolid = 10^-9."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density-filter radius and distance metric in CASES II and III",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 gives rmin = 3.6, and Eqs. 27–28 use element-center distances, but the coordinate unit is unspecified. This matters particularly if the half-domain elements are rectangular.",
      "readings": [
        "Compute distances in element-index coordinates, with one index step in either direction equal to one unit; radius is 3.6.",
        "Compute physical Euclidean distances with rmin = 3.6 times the element height.",
        "Compute physical Euclidean distances with rmin = 3.6 times the element width.",
        "Use rmin = 3.6 in domain coordinates normalized to Ly = 1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density filtering across the symmetry cut",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eqs. 27–29 define normalized neighboring-element averaging, but Sec. 4.1.1 does not state whether the filter is constructed on the half-domain or on the mirrored full domain.",
      "readings": [
        "Use only existing half-domain neighbors and renormalize the truncated neighborhood at the symmetry cut.",
        "Include reflected elements across the symmetry cut, equivalent to filtering the symmetric full-domain density field."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "bilinear quadrilateral stiffness integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies bilinear quadrilateral finite elements but does not specify the stiffness integration rule or stabilization.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node quadrilaterals with full 2 by 2 Gauss integration.",
        "Four-node quadrilaterals with one-point integration and hourglass stabilization.",
        "Four-node quadrilaterals with selective reduced integration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial design for the Table 2 single-material runs",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No initial natural-coordinate or physical-density field is supplied for Table 2. The initial-guess studies in Sec. 4.4 concern other cases and do not establish this initialization.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform initial solid density 0.30.",
        "Uniform initial solid density 0.50, corresponding to zero natural coordinates."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "MMA numerical controls",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 names MMA, but does not report move limits, asymptote controls, or subproblem convergence tolerances.",
      "readings": [
        "Initial asymptote offset 0.5 of the variable-bound span, expansion/contraction factors 1.2/0.7, no additional move limit, and subproblem tolerance 10^-7.",
        "The same asymptote controls and tolerance, with a maximum physical-density change of 0.10 per iteration.",
        "Initial asymptote offset 0.25 of the bound span, expansion/contraction factors 1.2/0.7, density move limit 0.20, and subproblem tolerance 10^-5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "outer optimization stopping rule",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies a maximum of 400 MMA iterations but supplies no early-stopping criterion or requirement to complete all continuation stages before stopping.",
      "readings": [
        "Always perform all 400 iterations.",
        "Stop when maximum physical-density change falls below 0.01, subject to the 400-iteration cap.",
        "Stop when relative objective change remains below 10^-4 for ten iterations, subject to the 400-iteration cap."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "other",
      "entity": "objective values reported in Table 2",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. 42 defines strain energy, and Secs. 3.3 and 4 specify objective normalization, but Table 2 does not identify whether its values include that normalization or represent half-domain versus reconstructed full-beam totals.",
      "readings": [
        "Unscaled half-domain strain energy.",
        "Unscaled full-beam strain energy, twice the half-domain value.",
        "Half-domain strain energy multiplied by nf.",
        "Full-beam strain energy multiplied by nf."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    }
  ]
}
